task.brief: Rank the six items by urgency — most urgent at the top.
task.thoughtIntro: Hover the speech bubble on a card to read the AI's reasoning for it.

end.title: Thank you for participating!
end.note: Your session is complete. You can now close this window.

hint.title: The AI shows you a hint
hint.intro: When you pick up a card, the AI highlights the slot it suggests for that card. It only hints — you decide where every card lands.
hint.footer: Pick up a card to see the AI's suggestion.

magnet.title: The AI pulls your cards
magnet.intro: Pick up a card and move it into the ranking. When the card comes near the slot the AI suggests, the AI pulls it toward that slot. You can always place it somewhere else: just keep moving the card where you want it.
magnet.footer: Near its suggested slot, the AI pulls the card in. Keep moving to place it elsewhere.

radial.title: The AI offers two options
radial.intro: Rest the pointer on a card in the inbox and the AI opens two placement options beside it. Hover an option to preview it, click to place the card. Or ignore the options and drag the card yourself.
radial.footer: The AI proposes two slots — pick one, or drag the card yourself.

heatmap.title: The AI shows how likely each slot is
heatmap.intro: Hover a card and every slot in the ranking lights up in purple: the deeper the purple, the more likely the AI thinks the card belongs there. It is only a suggestion — you place every card by hand.

handoff.title: The AI takes over when you pause
handoff.intro: Drag cards into the ranking. When you stop moving, the AI takes the cursor and continues sorting. Move the mouse again at any time to take back control.
handoff.footer: Pause to let the AI continue — move the mouse to take back control.

override.title: Sort first — then the AI reviews
override.intro: First, rank all six items yourself. When you are done, hand your ranking to the AI. The AI will review it and change what it disagrees with.
override.sortFirst: Rank all six items, then hand them over to the AI.
override.working: The AI is reviewing your ranking…
override.done: The AI changed {n} of your placements.
override.doneEdit: The AI changed {n} of your placements. You can still adjust the ranking before confirming.
